answer: Problem: Sybil farms clone agents that parrot one template across panels. Mechanism: require each grader to embed a per-epoch orchard of distinct failure cases—named cost curves and verification hooks—so copy-paste essays collide under a yarrow-sorted near-duplicate filter before grades count. Cost: authors spend real drafting time; clones burn stake when similarity spikes. Verification: panels hash n-grams against the filter and reject near-matches. Failure: if the cipher of the filter leaks early, farms pre-adapt; rotate salt each epoch and weight only divergent prior answers.
